senses.en: The upper front part of the body, enclosing heart and lungs.
A large strong box with a lid, used for storage.

ex.en: She held the sleeping kitten gently against her chest.
Workers exposed to polluted air may develop chest problems, highlighting the importance of effective workplace ventilation.

col: a chest of drawers｜tủ ngăn kéo
tip: chest là ngực hoặc cái rương lớn; tủ ngăn kéo là chest of drawers.

senses.zh: một cách tự nhiên; tự nhiên
senses.en: Through natural processes rather than human action
As would normally be expected
Because of qualities someone or something has from birth

ex.en: Let your hair dry naturally after you wash it.
Some pollutants occur naturally in the environment, but human activities can increase their concentration to harmful levels.

col: come naturally to someone｜đối với ai là điều dễ dàng
tip: Naturally đứng đầu câu thường nghĩa là “đương nhiên”, không nhất thiết là “tự nhiên”.

senses.en: almost not, or only to a very small degree
only just, before something else happens

ex.en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
Expanding roads alone is hardly sufficient to solve traffic congestion without improvements to public transport.

col: hardly ever｜hầu như không bao giờ
hardly surprising｜không có gì ngạc nhiên
tip: hardly nghĩa là hầu như không; không phải dạng trạng từ của hard.

senses.zh: sự an toàn; sự bình an
senses.en: the state of being protected from danger or harm

ex.en: Please wear a helmet for your own safety.
Improving road safety requires better street design as well as stricter enforcement of traffic laws.

col: for safety reasons｜vì lý do an toàn
tip: Thường không đếm được; safe là tính từ, safety là danh từ.

senses.zh: nhà tranh; nhà nhỏ ở nông thôn
senses.en: A small house, usually in the countryside.

ex.en: Their cottage has a tiny garden full of roses.
Converting an unused cottage into holiday accommodation can provide rural families with an additional source of income.

col: a country cottage｜ngôi nhà nhỏ ở nông thôn
a thatched cottage｜ngôi nhà mái tranh
a holiday cottage｜nhà nghỉ dưỡng nhỏ
tip: Thường chỉ nhà nhỏ ở vùng quê, không phải biệt thự sang trọng (villa).

senses.en: having a liking or affection for someone or something
showing or expressing warmth and affection

ex.en: My grandmother is fond of walking by the river.
Many adults retain fond memories of teachers who encouraged their curiosity and supported their ambitions.

col: a fond farewell｜lời tạm biệt đầy tình cảm
tip: be fond of đi với danh từ hoặc V-ing, không đi với to do.

senses.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

ex.en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.

col: hold an exhibition｜tổ chức một triển lãm
tip: exhibition là cả buổi triển lãm; exhibit có thể là một món được trưng bày.

senses.zh: sự khó khăn; sự vất vả
senses.en: The state of being hard to do or understand.

senses.zh: vấn đề nan giải; hoàn cảnh khó khăn
senses.en: A problem that makes progress or success harder.

ex.en: I had difficulty opening the jar with wet hands.
Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.

col: have difficulty doing something｜gặp khó khăn khi làm việc gì
tip: Dùng have difficulty doing, không dùng difficulty to do.

senses.en: The gas water becomes when heated, often seen as white mist.
To cook food using steam from boiling water.

ex.en: Steam rose from the soup as I lifted the lid.
Some power stations use heat to produce steam, which drives turbines and generates electricity.

col: run out of steam｜hết sức; hết hơi
tip: Danh từ steam thường không đếm được; làm động từ có thể là hấp thức ăn.

senses.zh: nỗi kinh hoàng; sự ghê sợ
senses.en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust
a type of fiction intended to frighten its audience

ex.en: She watched in horror as her laptop fell downstairs.
Horror films often use music and lighting to create tension rather than relying entirely on frightening images.

col: a sense of horror｜cảm giác kinh hoàng
tip: Nghĩa cảm xúc thường không đếm được; in horror nghĩa là kinh hoàng.

senses.en: a written account of someone's life by another person

ex.en: I'm reading a biography of an explorer before bed.
A well-researched biography can reveal how social conditions influence an individual's choices and achievements.

col: a biography of someone｜tiểu sử của ai đó
an authorised biography｜tiểu sử được ủy quyền
tip: biography là sách do người khác viết về cuộc đời ai đó; tự truyện là autobiography.

senses.en: to risk money on the result of an uncertain event
to say confidently that something is true or will happen
an agreement to risk money on an uncertain result

ex.en: I bet you left your keys in the kitchen.
Some investors bet on emerging technologies despite considerable uncertainty about their future commercial success.

col: a safe bet｜lựa chọn an toàn
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ thường vẫn là bet; I bet thường để diễn đạt sự chắc chắn.

senses.zh: địa điểm; công trường; di tích
senses.en: A place where something is built, happens, or once existed.
A collection of connected web pages.
Place or build something in a particular location.

ex.en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.

col: site a factory｜chọn địa điểm cho nhà máy
tip: site là địa điểm hoặc trang web; sight là thị lực hoặc cảnh tượng, hai từ đọc giống nhau.

senses.en: To say or write something in reply.
To react to something through actions or physical changes.

ex.en: I asked about dinner, but nobody responded to my message.
Healthcare systems must respond quickly to changing population needs while maintaining high standards of care.

col: respond to a question｜trả lời câu hỏi
respond to treatment｜phản ứng với điều trị
tip: respond to + đối tượng được đáp lại; không đi thẳng với tân ngữ.

senses.en: an arrangement accepted by two or more people or groups

senses.zh: sự đồng ý; sự nhất trí
senses.en: the state of sharing an opinion or accepting a proposal
a grammatical match between related words in a sentence

ex.en: We reached an agreement about sharing the kitchen.
International agreements on carbon emissions are more effective when participating countries establish clear targets and monitor progress.

col: reach an agreement｜đạt được thỏa thuận
be in agreement｜đồng ý với nhau
subject–verb agreement｜sự hòa hợp chủ ngữ và động từ
tip: Thỏa thuận cụ thể là đếm được; nghĩa nhất trí ý kiến thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A system of connected people, things or places.

senses.zh: mạng lưới phát sóng; hệ thống truyền hình
senses.en: A group of broadcasting stations sharing programmes.

senses.zh: kết nối quan hệ nghề nghiệp
senses.en: To meet people and develop useful professional relationships.

ex.en: Our home network connects three laptops and a printer.
An efficient public transport network can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment.

col: network with colleagues｜kết nối với đồng nghiệp
tip: network nhấn mạnh sự liên kết giữa nhiều nút với nhau.

senses.en: to have something inside or as a part
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This small box contains all my sewing supplies.
Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.

col: contain the spread｜ngăn chặn sự lây lan
contain your excitement｜kìm nén sự phấn khích
tip: Là ngoại động từ, đi thẳng với tân ngữ; nghĩa “chứa” thường không dùng thì tiếp diễn.

senses.zh: ánh sáng ban ngày; ban ngày
senses.en: Natural light from the sun, or the time it is available.

ex.en: Let's finish planting these flowers while there's still daylight.
Designing classrooms to receive more daylight can reduce electricity use and create a more comfortable learning environment.

col: in broad daylight｜giữa ban ngày ban mặt
natural daylight｜ánh sáng tự nhiên ban ngày
tip: Thường không đếm được; in broad daylight nghĩa là giữa ban ngày ban mặt.

senses.zh: giấy viết thư; giấy ghi chú
senses.en: paper used for writing letters or short messages

ex.en: She took some notepaper from the desk drawer.
Providing recycled notepaper in offices is a simple measure that can support more sustainable purchasing practices.

col: a sheet of notepaper｜một tờ giấy viết thư
a pad of notepaper｜một tập giấy ghi chú
personal notepaper｜giấy viết thư cá nhân
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; một tờ dùng a sheet of notepaper.

senses.en: Towards the back, or with the back facing forwards.

senses.zh: ngược lại; theo thứ tự đảo
senses.en: In the opposite order or direction to the usual one.

ex.en: She stepped backwards to let the cyclist pass.
Researchers can work backwards from current pollution levels to identify the likely sources of environmental damage.

tip: backwards là trạng từ; khi bổ nghĩa cho danh từ thường dùng backward.

senses.en: Having little colour, or less colour than usual.
Giving only a weak light.
To lose colour or seem less impressive in comparison.

ex.en: You look pale; sit down and have some water.
The financial benefits of tourism may pale in comparison with its long-term environmental costs.

col: pale in comparison｜lu mờ khi so sánh
tip: pale có thể chỉ gương mặt tái nhợt hoặc màu nhạt, không có nghĩa là màu trắng.

senses.en: Difficult to do, deal with, or endure
Able to cope with hardship, pain, or difficult conditions
Strong and difficult to break, cut, or damage

ex.en: It was a tough climb, but the view was worth it.
Governments face tough choices when balancing economic growth with the need to protect natural resources.

tip: Vần với rough; khi nói về thịt, tough nghĩa là dai, khó nhai.

senses.en: Sold without certain taxes, especially to international travellers.
Without paying certain taxes on goods.

ex.en: She bought some duty-free perfume before boarding her flight.
Duty-free shopping can generate substantial revenue for airports, although travellers may not always find the lowest prices.

tip: duty ở đây là thuế quan; hàng miễn thuế vẫn bị giới hạn định mức khi nhập cảnh.

senses.en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices

ex.en: We learned about different religions at school today.
Schools can teach students about religion while encouraging respect for people with different beliefs.

col: freedom of religion｜tự do tôn giáo
organised religion｜tôn giáo có tổ chức
tip: Nói chung về tôn giáo thì không đếm được; nói một tôn giáo cụ thể thì đếm được.

senses.en: a short sleep, usually during the day
to sleep briefly, usually during the day

ex.en: I took a short nap after lunch on Sunday.
A brief afternoon nap may improve alertness, but it should not replace adequate sleep at night.

col: take a nap｜chợp mắt một lát
a power nap｜giấc ngủ ngắn lấy lại sức
tip: Động từ phải gấp đôi chữ p: napped, napping.

senses.en: by a small amount or to a small degree

ex.en: Please open the window slightly; it feels warm.
Although average incomes rose slightly, many households continued to struggle with higher food and energy costs.

tip: Có thể bổ nghĩa cho tính từ, so sánh hơn hoặc động từ, như slightly higher.

senses.en: an official document allowing someone to do something
freedom to depart from usual rules or factual accuracy

ex.en: I keep my driving licence in my wallet.
Requiring a licence to operate tourist boats can help authorities maintain safety standards on busy waterways.

col: apply for a licence｜xin giấy phép
renew a licence｜gia hạn giấy phép
poetic licence｜sự tự do sáng tạo của nhà thơ
tip: Tiếng Anh–Anh: danh từ licence, động từ license; tiếng Anh–Mỹ dùng license cho cả hai.

senses.en: A large hunting bird with powerful claws and sharp eyesight

ex.en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.

col: a bald eagle｜đại bàng đầu trắng
tip: eagle thường chỉ chim săn mồi lớn; eagle-eyed nghĩa là mắt tinh.

senses.zh: văn bằng; chứng chỉ khóa học
senses.en: an official document showing successful completion of a course

ex.en: She proudly showed her diploma to her grandparents.
A vocational diploma can provide practical skills that help graduates find employment in specialised industries.

col: high school diploma｜bằng tốt nghiệp trung học
diploma in nursing｜chứng chỉ điều dưỡng
tip: diploma thường là văn bằng tốt nghiệp hoặc chứng chỉ khóa học, không bằng degree (bằng đại học).

senses.zh: sự khám phá; điều được phát hiện
senses.en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found

ex.en: We made an exciting discovery behind the old cupboard.
The discovery of new antibiotics could help health services respond more effectively to drug-resistant infections.

tip: discovery là tìm ra điều vốn có sẵn, khác với invention (phát minh).

senses.en: A series of actions or changes leading to a result.
Treat materials or information through a series of organised steps.

ex.en: Making bread is a slow process, but I enjoy it.
The application process should be transparent so that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate.

col: a gradual process｜một quá trình dần dần
in the process of｜đang trong quá trình
tip: in the process of đi với danh từ hoặc V-ing.

senses.zh: sự giải trí; hoạt động giải trí
senses.en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.

ex.en: The hotel provides live entertainment beside the pool every evening.
Affordable entertainment facilities can improve urban life by giving residents opportunities to relax and socialise.

col: the entertainment industry｜ngành công nghiệp giải trí
family entertainment｜giải trí cho cả gia đình
a form of entertainment｜một hình thức giải trí
tip: Thường không đếm được: cung cấp giải trí là provide entertainment.

senses.en: to think about something you do not know

senses.zh: sự kinh ngạc; sự thán phục
senses.en: a feeling of surprise and admiration
something unusually impressive or surprising

ex.en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.

tip: Sau wonder là mệnh đề nghi vấn thì dùng trật tự câu khẳng định.

senses.zh: sự thêm vào; sự bổ sung
senses.en: the act of putting something extra into something
the process of finding the total of quantities
something extra that joins an existing group or collection

ex.en: The addition of fresh lemon made the soup delicious.
The addition of cycle lanes can make urban transport safer and encourage residents to exercise regularly.

col: a welcome addition｜một sự bổ sung đáng hoan nghênh
tip: in addition là từ nối; in addition to đi với danh từ hoặc V-ing.

senses.en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The bakery delivers warm bread to our door every morning.
Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.

col: deliver a speech｜phát biểu một bài diễn văn
deliver on a promise｜thực hiện lời hứa
tip: Giao cái gì cho ai: deliver sth to sb; thực hiện lời hứa dùng deliver on.

senses.en: Covered with dust or containing a lot of dust.

ex.en: I wiped the dusty shelf with a damp cloth.
Workers in dusty environments need appropriate protective equipment to reduce their risk of developing respiratory diseases.

col: a dusty road｜con đường đầy bụi
a dusty environment｜môi trường nhiều bụi
tip: dusty tả cái gì có bụi; dust làm động từ có thể nghĩa là phủi bụi.

senses.zh: đóng băng; cứng đơ vì lạnh
senses.en: Turned into ice or made hard by extreme cold.
Kept at very low temperatures to preserve freshness.
Feeling extremely cold.

ex.en: A frozen puddle cracked beneath my boot this morning.
Frozen vegetables can help households reduce food waste because they remain usable much longer than fresh produce.

col: frozen with fear｜sợ đến đứng hình
tip: Cũng là quá khứ phân từ của freeze; quá khứ là froze.

senses.en: Happen, especially at a particular time or place.
Exist or be found in a particular place or situation.

senses.zh: chợt nghĩ ra; chợt nảy ra
senses.en: Come into someone's mind as an idea or thought.

ex.en: Power cuts often occur here during heavy winter storms.
Traffic accidents are more likely to occur when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.

col: occur to someone｜chợt nảy ra trong đầu ai
tip: Không dùng bị động; quá khứ là occurred, phân từ hiện tại là occurring.

senses.zh: môn đi bè; chèo bè vượt thác
senses.en: Travelling down a river on a raft for pleasure.

ex.en: We went rafting down a mountain river last weekend.
Rafting can support rural tourism, but operators must provide safety equipment and protect river habitats.

col: white-water rafting｜đi bè trên thác nước xiết
tip: Chỉ môn thể thao thường dùng go rafting; raft cũng là cái bè.

senses.en: Cheerful and full of enjoyment.

ex.en: Their merry laughter filled the kitchen as they baked.
Community festivals create a merry atmosphere that encourages residents of different ages to interact and build friendships.

col: a merry crowd｜đám đông vui nhộn
tip: Thường dùng cho không khí lễ hội; make merry nghĩa là vui chơi ăn mừng.

senses.en: To give someone facts or tell them about something.

senses.zh: làm cơ sở cho; cung cấp thông tin cho
senses.en: To provide knowledge that shapes a decision, opinion, or approach.

ex.en: Please inform the receptionist if you lose your key.
Reliable research should inform government decisions about how to allocate funding for public health services.

col: inform someone of something｜thông báo cho ai về điều gì
keep someone informed｜luôn cập nhật cho ai
inform policy｜làm căn cứ cho chính sách
tip: Báo cho ai biết việc gì dùng inform sb of/about sth.

senses.en: The curved line of hair above each eye.

ex.en: He raised one eyebrow when he saw the enormous cake.
Facial movements, such as raising an eyebrow, can communicate surprise without relying on spoken language.

tip: eyebrow là lông mày; eyelash là lông mi.

senses.en: a reduction in the usual price
to sell something at a reduced price
to consider something unlikely or less important

ex.en: The shop offers a discount on winter coats.
Public transport discounts can encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.

col: discount the possibility｜gạt bỏ khả năng
tip: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu; động từ thường đọc /dɪsˈkaʊnt/.

senses.en: The spirit of a dead person, imagined as appearing alive.

senses.zh: chút xíu; dấu vết mờ nhạt
senses.en: A very slight trace of a feeling, expression, or quality.

ex.en: My little cousin dressed as a ghost for the party.
Local ghost stories can attract tourists while revealing how communities interpret their history and cultural traditions.

col: a ghost town｜thị trấn bỏ hoang
a ghost of a smile｜thoáng một nụ cười
tip: a ghost of a smile nghĩa là một nụ cười thoáng qua.

senses.en: To pay someone to do a job.
To pay to use something for a limited time.
An arrangement to use something temporarily in exchange for payment.

ex.en: We hired a van to move our furniture.
Businesses that hire local workers can strengthen regional economies and reduce the need for long commutes.

tip: Thuê xe trong tiếng Anh–Anh thường dùng hire, trong tiếng Anh–Mỹ thường dùng rent.

senses.en: Without a paid job but available for work

ex.en: My neighbour has been unemployed since the factory closed.
Providing affordable training for unemployed adults can help them develop skills that match changing labour market demands.

col: the long-term unemployed｜người thất nghiệp dài hạn
tip: the unemployed chỉ nhóm người thất nghiệp, động từ chia số nhiều.

senses.zh: tích cực; lạc quan; có lợi
senses.en: Hopeful, confident, or producing a good effect.
Completely certain that something is true.
Showing a condition is present, or mathematically greater than zero.

ex.en: She stayed positive even when rain spoiled our picnic.
Regular contact with nature can have a positive effect on children's emotional development and overall wellbeing.

col: positive result｜kết quả dương tính; kết quả tốt
tip: Kết quả xét nghiệm positive là dương tính, không nhất thiết là tin tốt.

senses.en: A person who plays drums, especially in a musical group.

ex.en: The drummer tapped her sticks together before the song.
A skilled drummer helps musicians maintain a steady rhythm, which is essential for a coordinated live performance.

col: a skilled drummer｜tay trống điêu luyện
a jazz drummer｜tay trống nhạc jazz
the band's drummer｜tay trống của ban nhạc
tip: drum thêm -er thành drummer, chú ý gấp đôi chữ m.

senses.en: to separate something into parts or share it among people
to calculate how many times one quantity fits into another
a major difference separating people or groups

ex.en: Let's divide the cake into slices before everyone arrives.
Unequal access to reliable internet services can deepen the digital divide between urban and rural communities.

col: divide into groups｜chia thành các nhóm
the digital divide｜khoảng cách kỹ thuật số
tip: divide into nghĩa là chia thành; divide by nghĩa là chia cho.

senses.en: to identify someone or something known from before
to accept or understand that something is true or important

senses.zh: chính thức công nhận; ghi nhận
senses.en: to officially accept something or honour someone's achievements

ex.en: I recognised your brother immediately, despite his new haircut.
Schools increasingly recognise that regular physical activity can improve both students' health and academic performance.

col: recognise a face｜nhận ra một gương mặt
recognise the importance of｜nhận thức được tầm quan trọng của
tip: recognise là cách viết Anh–Anh; tiếng Anh–Mỹ thường viết recognize.

senses.en: Located above another part or nearer the top.
Higher in rank, level, or position within a range.

ex.en: Keep the spare blankets on the upper shelf.
Residents on the upper floors of apartment buildings may face difficulties when lifts stop working.

tip: Thường đứng trước danh từ, như upper floor; từ trái nghĩa là lower.

senses.en: The money paid for a journey on public transport.
To perform or experience a particular level of success.
Food of a particular kind served in a place.

ex.en: I had just enough coins for the bus fare.
Reducing train fares could encourage commuters to leave their cars at home and use public transport.

tip: fare là giá vé giao thông; fee thường là phí dịch vụ hoặc học phí.

senses.en: Having a particular value in money.
Deserving the time, effort, or money something requires.
The value, importance, or usefulness of something.

ex.en: This old bicycle is still worth fifty pounds.
Investing in public transport is worth the initial expense because it can reduce congestion and pollution.

col: be worth the effort｜đáng để nỗ lực
prove your worth｜chứng tỏ giá trị của bản thân
tip: Nói đáng làm gì dùng be worth doing, không dùng worth to do.

senses.en: The part of a garment that surrounds the neck.
A band worn around an animal's neck.
To catch or stop someone, often to speak to them.

ex.en: He straightened his shirt collar before the interview.
A well-fitted collar allows owners to attach a lead and keep dogs under control in public spaces.

col: turn up your collar｜dựng cổ áo lên
tip: white-collar là “cổ cồn trắng” (nhân viên văn phòng); blue-collar là “cổ cồn xanh” (lao động chân tay).

senses.en: Physical harm to someone's body, often caused by an accident

ex.en: His knee injury kept him away from football practice.
Employers should provide regular safety training to reduce the risk of injury among workers operating heavy machinery.

col: a knee injury｜chấn thương đầu gối
risk of injury｜nguy cơ chấn thương
tip: Chỉ vết thương cụ thể thì đếm được; chỉ tổn hại thân thể nói chung thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: to bend something so one part lies over another
a bend or crease in paper, cloth, or skin
to close because a business cannot continue operating

ex.en: Please fold these towels and put them on the shelf.
Small businesses may fold when rising rental costs make it impossible to maintain a reasonable profit.

col: fold up a chair｜gập ghế lại
fold the laundry｜gấp quần áo đã giặt
tip: fold nhấn mạnh gấp chồng lên nhau; bend chỉ là uốn cong.

senses.zh: đáng tin cậy; tin tưởng được
senses.en: Able to be trusted to work well or behave consistently

ex.en: Our old car is still reliable in cold weather.
Access to reliable information helps citizens make informed decisions about their health and finances.

col: reliable information｜thông tin đáng tin cậy
reliable service｜dịch vụ đáng tin cậy
tip: reliable có thể tả người, thông tin hoặc máy móc, nhấn mạnh sự đáng tin.

senses.en: The outside or top layer of something
To rise to the top of water
To become known or noticeable after being hidden

ex.en: Wipe the kitchen surface before you start preparing lunch.
Dark road surfaces absorb heat during the day, contributing to higher temperatures in urban areas.

col: a smooth surface｜một bề mặt nhẵn
the Earth's surface｜bề mặt Trái Đất
beneath the surface｜bên dưới bề mặt
tip: on the surface nghĩa là “trên bề mặt”, cũng có thể là “nhìn bề ngoài”.

senses.en: A particular form of something that exists in different forms
One person's account of an event

ex.en: The new version of this app loads much faster.
Comparing each witness's version of events helps investigators develop a more accurate understanding of what happened.

col: the latest version｜phiên bản mới nhất
an updated version｜phiên bản cập nhật
a version of events｜một cách kể về sự kiện
a film version｜phiên bản điện ảnh
tip: version chỉ các dạng khác nhau của cùng một thứ, cũng chỉ lời kể riêng của một người về sự việc.

senses.en: To become liquid through heat, or make something become liquid
To become gentler emotionally, or make someone feel this way

ex.en: The butter melted quickly in the warm pan.
As global temperatures rise, mountain glaciers melt faster, threatening freshwater supplies for communities downstream.

col: melt someone's heart｜làm mềm lòng ai
tip: melt là tan chảy do nhiệt; dissolve là hòa tan trong chất lỏng.

senses.en: Across many places or among many people
With a large difference between people, things, or situations

ex.en: This fruit is widely available in local shops.
Although online learning is widely accepted, access to reliable internet connections still varies considerably between regions.

col: widely used｜được sử dụng rộng rãi
widely accepted｜được chấp nhận rộng rãi
tip: widely chỉ phạm vi rộng; wide còn có thể nghĩa là mở rộng hết cỡ.

senses.en: a device that joins papers using small metal staples

ex.en: Could you pass me the stapler beside your notebook?
Providing basic office equipment, such as staplers and printers, helps community centres support residents seeking employment.

col: a desk stapler｜kim bấm để bàn
refill a stapler｜nạp ghim cho kim bấm
tip: stapler là cái dập ghim; staple là ghim bấm, cũng là động từ.

senses.zh: sơ cứu; cấp cứu ban đầu
senses.en: Used for immediate basic care after injury or sudden illness.

ex.en: There is a first-aid kit in the kitchen cupboard.
Employers should provide first-aid training so that staff can respond effectively to minor workplace injuries.

tip: Danh từ viết first aid; đứng trước danh từ thì có thể thêm gạch nối.

senses.en: A feeling of great happiness

senses.zh: điều/ người mang lại niềm vui
senses.en: A person or thing that brings great happiness

ex.en: The children jumped for joy when the snow began.
Community gardens can bring joy to residents while strengthening social connections and encouraging healthier lifestyles.

col: jump for joy｜nhảy cẫng lên vì vui
tears of joy｜nước mắt hạnh phúc
the joys of parenthood｜những niềm vui khi làm cha mẹ
tip: Niềm vui thường không đếm được; điều đem lại niềm vui thì đếm được, như a joy.

senses.en: To leave something out or not do something expected.
To move with light hops or jump over a swinging rope.

ex.en: I skipped breakfast because I woke up too late.
Students who regularly skip classes may struggle to develop the knowledge required for more advanced courses.

col: skip a class｜trốn một tiết học
skip a step｜bỏ qua một bước
tip: skip đi thẳng với tân ngữ; skipped, skipping phải gấp đôi chữ p.

senses.en: a person whose job is to protect people or places

senses.zh: canh giữ; bảo vệ; trông chừng
senses.en: to protect someone or something from danger or escape

senses.zh: bộ phận bảo vệ; tấm chắn
senses.en: a cover or barrier that prevents injury or damage

ex.en: The guard checked my ticket before opening the gate.
Museums employ trained staff to guard valuable collections while ensuring that visitors can enjoy them safely.

tip: guard against nghĩa là phòng tránh một rủi ro hoặc sai sót.

senses.en: to draw a line beneath a word or phrase
to show that something is especially important

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to underline the unfamiliar words.
These findings underline the importance of providing affordable housing near public transport for families on low incomes.

col: underline a word｜gạch chân một từ
underline the importance of｜nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của
underline the need for｜làm nổi bật nhu cầu về
tip: Nghĩa gốc là gạch chân bên dưới, cũng thường dùng để nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng.

senses.en: A small, narrow river.

senses.zh: dòng người hoặc vật liên tục
senses.en: A continuous flow of people or things.
To flow continuously, or play media directly over the internet.

ex.en: We crossed the shallow stream on flat stones.
Many students now stream educational videos at home, making reliable internet access increasingly important for learning.

col: a steady stream of visitors｜dòng khách đến liên tục
tip: a stream of chỉ dòng người hoặc vật nối tiếp nhau.

senses.en: A formal dance style, or a performance using this style.

ex.en: My sister practises ballet at the studio every Saturday.
Public funding for ballet can help preserve artistic traditions and make performances accessible to a wider audience.

col: ballet lessons｜các buổi học ba lê
tip: Chữ t cuối không đọc; tiếng Anh–Anh nhấn âm đầu, tiếng Anh–Mỹ nhấn âm sau.

senses.en: sadness because something was not as good as expected
someone or something that fails to meet your hopes

ex.en: Her face showed disappointment when the picnic was cancelled.
Teaching young people to cope with disappointment can help them respond more positively to academic setbacks.

col: to my disappointment｜khiến tôi thất vọng
a bitter disappointment｜một nỗi thất vọng cay đắng
cope with disappointment｜đối mặt với sự thất vọng
tip: Nói cảm xúc thường không đếm được; nói điều gây thất vọng thì dùng a disappointment.

senses.zh: buổi tập luyện; bài tập thể dục
senses.en: a period of physical exercise to improve strength or fitness

ex.en: After a short workout, I felt ready for breakfast.
A regular workout can improve physical health and help office workers manage stress more effectively.

col: intense workout｜buổi tập cường độ cao
tip: workout là danh từ; cụm động từ work out viết rời nhau.

senses.en: A spiritual being believed to carry messages from God

senses.zh: người tốt bụng; người đáng yêu
senses.en: Someone who is exceptionally kind or helpful

ex.en: The painting shows an angel with shining white wings.
Images of angels appear in religious art and can reveal important aspects of a society's beliefs.

col: an absolute angel｜một người cực kỳ tốt bụng
tip: Gọi ai đó là an angel có thể nghĩa là họ rất tốt hoặc đã giúp đỡ rất nhiều.

senses.zh: sự mất mát; sự thất lạc; thiệt hại
senses.en: The fact of no longer having someone or something.
Money lost when costs are higher than income.
A defeat in a game or competition.

ex.en: She reported the loss of her wallet yesterday.
The loss of natural habitats threatens biodiversity and can weaken ecosystems that support local agriculture.

col: at a loss｜bối rối; lỗ vốn
a financial loss｜thiệt hại tài chính
tip: loss là danh từ, lose là động từ, quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ là lost.

senses.en: Growing crops or raising animals for food and other products

ex.en: My grandparents earn their living from sheep farming.
Sustainable farming can protect soil quality while providing enough food for a growing population.

tip: Nói chung về nông nghiệp thì thường không đếm được; chăn nuôi cũng dùng farming.

senses.en: Something valuable accomplished through effort or skill.

senses.zh: sự đạt được; sự hoàn thành
senses.en: The successful completion of a goal through effort.

ex.en: Finishing my first long hike felt like a real achievement.
Schools should recognise creative achievements alongside examination results to encourage a wider range of student abilities.

col: a major achievement｜một thành tựu lớn
a sense of achievement｜cảm giác thành tựu
the achievement of goals｜việc đạt được mục tiêu
tip: Thành tựu cụ thể thì đếm được; việc đạt được mục tiêu thì thường không đếm được.

senses.zh: làm đổ; tràn ra; rơi vãi
senses.en: To accidentally let liquid or loose material escape its container.
An amount of liquid spilled, or an incident involving spilling.

ex.en: I spilled orange juice all over my clean shirt.
Oil spills can damage marine ecosystems and threaten the livelihoods of communities that depend on fishing.

col: spill a drink｜làm đổ đồ uống
spill the beans｜tiết lộ bí mật
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ có thể là spilled hoặc spilt.

senses.en: A small place providing paid accommodation, often in someone's home.

ex.en: We found a cosy guesthouse overlooking the fishing harbour.
Family-run guesthouses can support rural economies by encouraging tourists to spend money in local communities.

col: stay at a guesthouse｜ở một nhà nghỉ
family-run guesthouse｜nhà nghỉ do gia đình điều hành
tip: Thường chỉ chỗ lưu trú nhỏ, không dùng cho khách sạn lớn.

senses.en: Having an edge or point that cuts or pierces easily.
Sudden and large in degree or amount.
Quick to notice, understand, or respond to things.

ex.en: This knife is sharp enough to slice tomatoes easily.
A sharp increase in housing costs has forced many young adults to delay moving out of their parents' homes.

col: sharp contrast｜sự tương phản rõ rệt
tip: Khi tả sự thay đổi, sharp thường chỉ sự thay đổi lớn và đột ngột, như a sharp rise.

senses.en: an arrangement for managing money or accessing a service
a spoken or written description of events
with for: explain something or constitute a share of something

ex.en: I opened a savings account at the local bank.
Transport costs account for a substantial share of household spending, particularly in areas with limited public services.

col: take into account｜cân nhắc; tính đến
tip: account for có thể nghĩa là giải thích nguyên nhân hoặc chiếm một tỷ lệ nào đó.

senses.en: not caring about others' feelings or treating them kindly

ex.en: It was unkind to laugh at his first drawing.
Schools should teach children how unkind comments online can affect the emotional wellbeing of their classmates.

col: be unkind to someone｜đối xử không tử tế với ai
unkind behaviour｜hành vi không tử tế
tip: Nói đối xử không tử tế với ai dùng be unkind to someone.

senses.zh: sự im lặng; sự yên tĩnh
senses.en: a lack of sound or speech
to stop someone or something making noise or expressing opinions

ex.en: We sat in silence as the snow fell outside.
Extended periods of silence in classrooms can give students valuable time to reflect on difficult questions.

col: break the silence｜phá vỡ sự im lặng
tip: in silence nghĩa là âm thầm; silent là tính từ.

senses.en: the dividing line between countries or regions
a strip around the outside edge of something
to share a boundary with a place

ex.en: We crossed the border by train early this morning.
Countries that share a border often need to cooperate closely on trade and environmental protection.

col: cross the border｜vượt qua biên giới
share a border｜có chung biên giới
a decorative border｜đường viền trang trí
tip: Động từ border đi thẳng với địa điểm; border on còn có thể nghĩa là gần như.

senses.zh: chấp nhận được; đạt yêu cầu
senses.en: good enough or suitable to be allowed or approved

ex.en: These shoes are acceptable for work, but trainers aren't.
Governments must establish acceptable limits for industrial emissions to protect public health and nearby ecosystems.

col: acceptable standard｜tiêu chuẩn chấp nhận được
socially acceptable｜được xã hội chấp nhận
acceptable to everyone｜mọi người đều chấp nhận được
tip: acceptable nghĩa là đạt yêu cầu, không có nghĩa là xuất sắc.

senses.zh: đáng xấu hổ; gây ngượng ngùng
senses.en: Making someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable

ex.en: It was embarrassing when my phone rang during the ceremony.
Students may avoid asking questions if they believe that making mistakes in front of classmates is embarrassing.

col: an embarrassing mistake｜một sai lầm đáng xấu hổ
an embarrassing situation｜một tình huống khó xử
tip: Sự việc làm người khác ngượng dùng embarrassing; người cảm thấy ngượng dùng embarrassed.

senses.zh: tập sách nhỏ; sổ tay mỏng
senses.en: a small, thin book, usually containing practical information

ex.en: The nurse gave me a booklet about healthy eating.
An illustrated booklet can make essential health advice more accessible to patients with limited reading skills.

col: a booklet on｜một tập sách nhỏ về
tip: -let thường chỉ nhỏ; booklet là cuốn sách mỏng nhỏ.

senses.en: The activity of chasing and catching or killing wild animals.
The activity of trying to find something.

ex.en: We spotted fresh animal tracks during our hunting trip.
Restrictions on hunting can help protect endangered species and maintain balanced ecosystems in vulnerable natural habitats.

col: a hunting ban｜lệnh cấm săn bắn
tip: Thường không đếm được; job hunting nghĩa là tìm việc.

senses.en: A long written story about imaginary people and events.
New and different from what is already known.

ex.en: I finished the novel on the train yesterday.
Schools can use historical novels to help students understand how ordinary people experienced major social changes.

col: write a novel｜viết một cuốn tiểu thuyết
novel approach｜cách tiếp cận mới lạ
tip: Làm danh từ là tiểu thuyết dài; làm tính từ là mới mẻ.

senses.en: Showing good judgment based on knowledge and experience.

ex.en: Taking a warm coat was a wise decision today.
It would be wise for governments to invest in preventive healthcare rather than rely solely on hospital treatment.

col: a wise decision｜một quyết định sáng suốt
wise to do something｜làm việc gì là khôn ngoan
tip: wise nhấn mạnh phán đoán sáng suốt; clever nhấn mạnh sự thông minh, nhanh trí.

senses.zh: linh mục; tu sĩ; thầy tế
senses.en: a person authorised to perform religious ceremonies

ex.en: The priest welcomed everyone as they entered the church.
In many communities, a priest provides emotional support and helps organise assistance for families in need.

col: a Catholic priest｜linh mục Công giáo
be ordained a priest｜được thụ phong linh mục
tip: Không phải mọi tu sĩ đều gọi là priest; nhà sư thường gọi là monk.

senses.en: expressing pessimism or having a harmful effect
expressing refusal or showing that something tested for is absent
less than zero

ex.en: Her negative comments made me doubt my cooking skills.
Heavy reliance on private cars can have negative effects on air quality and public health.

col: test negative for｜xét nghiệm âm tính
tip: Kết quả xét nghiệm negative nghĩa là âm tính, không phải kết quả xấu.

senses.en: A person who buys goods or services for personal use.

ex.en: As a consumer, I always compare prices before buying.
Governments should protect consumers by requiring companies to provide accurate information about their products.

col: consumer rights｜quyền lợi người tiêu dùng
consumer protection｜bảo vệ người tiêu dùng
tip: consumer nhấn mạnh người tiêu dùng; customer nhấn mạnh mối quan hệ giao dịch với cửa hàng.

senses.en: the legally or socially recognised relationship between two spouses
a successful combination of different things

ex.en: Their marriage grew stronger as they learned to listen.
Changing attitudes towards marriage have influenced household structures and housing demand in many societies.

col: a happy marriage｜một cuộc hôn nhân hạnh phúc
marriage certificate｜giấy đăng ký kết hôn
marriage to someone｜cuộc hôn nhân với ai
tip: marriage là quan hệ hôn nhân; wedding chủ yếu là đám cưới.

senses.en: a competition involving several games between different players or teams

ex.en: Our school tennis tournament starts next Saturday morning.
Hosting an international tournament can boost tourism, but maintaining sports facilities afterwards may prove expensive.

col: host a tournament｜đăng cai giải đấu
enter a tournament｜đăng ký tham gia giải đấu
win a tournament｜giành chiến thắng giải đấu
tip: Thường gồm nhiều trận; một trận đơn thường dùng match hoặc game.

senses.en: having a baby developing inside the body

ex.en: My cousin is pregnant and expects her baby in June.
Accessible healthcare helps pregnant women receive regular check-ups and reliable advice throughout their pregnancy.

tip: Nói mang thai được bao lâu có thể dùng six months pregnant.

senses.en: A piece of material covering or protecting a surface.
To twist hair or fibres into a thick tangled mass.

ex.en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before entering.
Placing a rubber mat near each entrance can help prevent slips in busy public buildings.

tip: mat thường là tấm thảm nhỏ có công dụng cụ thể, khác với carpet.

senses.en: Push firmly against something.
Newspapers, magazines, and the journalists who produce them.
Try firmly to persuade someone to do something.

ex.en: Press this button to open the garage door.
A free press helps citizens understand public affairs and holds those in power accountable.

col: freedom of the press｜tự do báo chí
press for change｜thúc giục cải cách
tip: Báo chí thường dùng the press; nhấn nút không cần push down.

senses.en: To get someone to do something by giving reasons
To make someone believe something is true

ex.en: I persuaded my brother to join our walking group.
Public health campaigns can persuade people to adopt healthier habits by explaining the benefits in accessible language.

col: persuade someone to do something｜thuyết phục ai làm gì
persuade someone of something｜làm ai tin điều gì
tip: persuade sb to do nhấn mạnh đã thuyết phục được, không chỉ là đề xuất.

senses.en: The sport of competing to move faster than others.
Designed or used for races.

ex.en: My cousin enjoys watching bicycle racing on weekend afternoons.
Professional motor racing encourages technological innovation, but its environmental impact remains a subject of debate.

tip: Tên môn thể thao thường không đếm được; một cuộc đua là a race.

senses.en: A toilet or a room containing one.

ex.en: The lavatory is just beyond the waiting room.
Every passenger carriage should include a lavatory that travellers with limited mobility can access easily.

col: public lavatory｜nhà vệ sinh công cộng
tip: Khá trang trọng, hay gặp trong tiếng Anh–Anh; hằng ngày thường dùng toilet.

senses.en: A weapon designed to explode and cause damage.
To attack a place using bombs.

ex.en: The museum displayed an empty bomb casing behind glass.
Construction projects may be delayed when workers discover an unexploded bomb left over from a past conflict.

col: an unexploded bomb｜quả bom chưa nổ
a bomb disposal team｜đội xử lý bom
tip: Chữ b cuối không đọc; bombing chỉ việc ném bom hoặc đánh bom.
